args.text: Hi June, Dana Okafor (North) has asked me to draft a mail to Hollis Mbeki with the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines ($2,356 a seat, from her call with the customer, not yet in any document) for the territory review. Hollis isn't on the finance-figures list, so I haven't drafted it. Can you approve that draft, or tell Dana otherwise? Anselm could also approve it. I'll hold until one of you replies.

So I've asked June Osei-Lark on the deal desk to approve the draft, and I've sent her the details. Anselm could also approve it. Once one of them says yes, I'll save the draft with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" for you to send. If you'd rather not wait, you can write the mail yourself.

- **Not done yet:** No draft exists. Once June or Anselm says yes, I'll save it with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" for you to send.
- **Your ownership:** I can't check from the directory that you own the Quarrendon account. Approval covers that, so it doesn't change the outcome.

I've told you the same in this DM. If you don't want to wait, you can write the mail yourself.
I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.
